senses.gloss: אַמְרֵי to provoke. [Targ. Zech. XII, 10, v. מְרר].—
units: <cite ref="Sotah 35b:1">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite> top <he>מאן אַמְרִיךְ דאִימַּרְיַית</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite>: <he>אימרייך דאימרת</he>, corr. acc.) who provoked thee that thou didst get angry?; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:7">Num. R. s. 5</cite>, end.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:8">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> (play on <he>א̇מ̇ר̇פל̇</he>) <he>דא̇מ̇ר̇י וא̇פ̇ל̇י וכ׳</he> he provoked and made sport of &c.

senses.gloss: to get angry. Num. R. l. c. דאִמַּרְיַת; Sot. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:10">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>אִימַּרְיָא</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="M02530"><he>מְרַד</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 58b:3">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>אִימְּרָאִי</he> … <he>לבקא</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="B01111"><he>בַּקָּא</he></cite> (ed. <he>אִימְּרָא … מב׳</he> she ran away in anger from &c., v. <cite ref="M02530"><he>מְרַד</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Ketubot 63b:1">Keth. 63ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A01349"><he>אימראי</he></cite> quot. in Rashi to <cite ref="Job 39:18">Job XXXIX, 18</cite> (ed. <he>אימרדה</he>).

senses.gloss: to refuse to abide by a bargain; to retract.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a:7">B. Mets. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>אייקרא … ואִימְּרוּ פועלים</he> labor became dearer, and the laborers struck.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ואימרי בעה״ב</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ואימר</he>, fr. <cite ref="J00423"><he>ימר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M00603"><he>מוּר</he> I</cite>) and the employer refused &c.
